// Filter posts that are ready to send (within the next 5 minutes)
const now = Date.now();
const readyPosts = posts.filter(p => {
  const scheduled = new Date(p.scheduledAt).getTime();
  return scheduled <= now + 5 * 60 * 1000;
});

return readyPosts.map(post => ({ json: post }));
